instruction: You are at the entrance of the door where looking straight you will sofa and chairs,just walk through the door inside the room and just entering the room just turn towards your right and walk through the narrow path which is between a wall painting and white sofa.Walk through the path.Walk near to the glass door which is quite open.just walk near to that door.And from here you can see a dining table setup to your left.walk near to dining table setup.And looking straight you can find the kitchen area where you can find three bar stools.just walk near to it.and walk near to kitchen sink and walk till you reach the end wall cupboards and now turn left and stand in-front of sink.This is final end point.You have reached the destination
